canonicalisation.note: ASCII keys only; floats, lone surrogates and non-ASCII keys are fatal

formal_model.reason: TLA+/TLC and Hypothesis unavailable on the build host; the design left the choice to implementation time

audit_chain.external_anchor_note: spec §12.2 reviewed fallback, chosen over the macOS System Keychain baseline because the runtime is a non-login service account

claim_boundary.receipt_proves: the gateway committed and accounted a disclosure under the named authority, provenance, egress and coverage state; v2 receipts record owner-direct authorization and whether the soft threshold was exceeded, v1 receipts the consent that authorised them
receipt_does_not_prove: that a remote client received the response
a long-term cryptographic commitment to exact private message bytes
claim_boundary.exposure_budget_bound: limits burst rate within the rolling window, not lifetime exposure
claim_boundary.audit_chain_bound: detects database-only tampering; not resistance to an attacker holding both the daemon account and the anchor
claim_boundary.third_parties: participants in the disclosed conversations do not consent and cannot object; out of scope for v0.1.10 and comms v0.2
